items.title: Schneider National (SNDR) Expands Eastern U.S. Intermodal Capacity Through New Rail Partnership
items.summary: Schneider National (NYSE:SNDR) has entered a new partnership with Norfolk Southern to expand domestic intermodal capacity in the eastern U.S. The collaboration combines Schneider National's asset based logistics network with Norfolk Southern's rail infrastructure to support more freight volume. Management expects the initiative to support a shift from long haul truckload freight toward rail based intermodal service for shippers.
